trainingPage.intro: Practical, partner-delivered training across four tracks: AI and copilots, software development, automation and workflows, and AI governance. From half-day workshops to multi-week cohorts, built around your real work rather than slides.

items.question: Do you train on-site or remotely?
items.answer: Both. Workshops and cohorts run on-site at your office or fully remote, whichever suits your team.

items.question: Which languages do you deliver in?
items.answer: English and French. Sessions, materials and questions are handled in either language.

items.question: Is the content tailored to us?
items.answer: Yes. Every session is scoped to your stack, your team's level and the outcomes you care about.

items.question: Do you certify attendees?
items.answer: Partner-certified programmes carry certification from our accredited training partners. Workshops come with materials and a completion summary.

items.question: How many people can attend?
items.answer: Workshops suit small groups. Cohorts run as multi-week programmes for a whole team. We right-size it on the scoping call.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Request a training session or book a 15-minute call. We scope it with you and come back with a plan and a quote.

items.question: How do we book training?
items.answer: Use Request training dates. Tell us which tracks you want, the format that suits your team, and two or three preferred dates. We reply with the slots we can confirm, usually within two working days.

items.question: Can we choose our own dates?
items.answer: Yes. The request form takes two or three preferred dates plus an optional note on your wider timeframe. We hold the closest match we can staff and confirm it by email before anything is booked.

items.question: Which topics do you cover?
items.answer: Four tracks: AI, software development, automation and workflows, and AI governance and compliance. Each track is shaped around your real work, so we drop or deepen individual topics to fit the team.

items.question: How do we become a training partner?
items.answer: Use Become a training partner. Tell us what you deliver, your accreditations and which tracks you can co-deliver. We review every application and reply either way.

items.question: What is corporate AI training?
items.answer: Corporate AI training is hands-on upskilling that teaches your team to use AI, automation and modern development safely inside your real workflows, covering practical tools alongside AI governance and compliance, rather than generic theory.

items.question: How long is a workshop or a cohort?
items.answer: Workshops run as focused half-day or full-day sessions for a small group. Cohorts run as multi-week, build-alongside programmes for a whole team. We right-size the length to your team's level on the scoping call.

items.question: How much does corporate AI training cost?
items.answer: Training is priced per programme, based on the tracks, format and group size, and agreed in writing before booking. Tell us your tracks and preferred dates and we come back with a fixed quote, usually within two working days.

items.question: Workshop or cohort: which format suits my team?
items.answer: Choose a workshop for a small group that needs one focused skill in a single session. Choose a cohort when a whole team needs durable capability built over several weeks alongside their real work.

trainingPage.finalText: Tell us your tools, your team and what you want them to be able to do. We come back with a training plan and a quote, with no obligation.

faq.heading: AI automation, answered
faq.intro: Workflow automation connects the tools your team already uses so repetitive steps run without manual handling, with a full audit trail. Here is how we approach it for UK and EU SMEs.

items.q: What is workflow automation for SMEs?
items.a: Workflow automation connects the tools you already use, such as your CRM, helpdesk, spreadsheets and email, so repetitive steps run without manual handling. For SMEs it typically removes data re-entry, chasing and status updates, freeing hours of admin time while keeping every step logged and traceable.

items.q: How long does it take to automate a workflow?
items.a: A single workflow ships in about 10 business days through the AI Ops Sprint. Production-grade automation across three to five tools takes four to six weeks through the Automation Build. Both are fixed-scope and agreed before any work starts.

We work with the tools most UK and EU SMEs already run, including HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Notion, Zendesk, Xero and Zapier or Make. If your stack is not listed, we scope the integration on a short call.

items.q: Is AI automation GDPR and EU AI Act ready?
items.a: Yes. Every build is GDPR-by-design with least-privilege access, clear data-retention notes, and a complete audit trail. Work is scoped to stay clear of prohibited EU AI Act use cases.

items.q: AI Ops Sprint vs Automation Build: which do I need?
items.a: Choose the AI Ops Sprint to automate one workflow or ship one AI copilot in about 10 business days, ideal for a quick proof of value. Choose the Automation Build for production-grade automation across three to five connected tools, with approvals, monitoring and error handling, over four to six weeks.

An MVP, or minimum viable product, is the smallest version of a product that proves your core idea with real users. It includes the essential features needed to validate one hypothesis and learn quickly, rather than a full feature set.

aeo.q: MVP vs full product: when should I build an MVP?
aeo.a: Build an MVP when you need to validate one hypothesis with real users fast, in weeks and at fixed scope. Move to a fuller product once the core is proven and demand for more features, scale or integrations is clear.

hero.title: Automation UK and EU SMEs can actually trust
hero.lede: InnoviaBurst builds GDPR-by-design AI automation, AI copilots and MVPs for small and mid-sized teams across the UK and EU. Fixed scope, delivered in weeks, with a full audit trail.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Enterprise-grade automation has been out of reach for most SMEs: too expensive, too slow, and too risky to govern. We exist to change that: to give smaller teams the same leverage from AI and automation that large companies enjoy, without the enterprise overhead or the compliance headaches.

what.title: What we do
what.body: We scope, build and ship four things, each scoped and quoted per project, with a clear, measurable outcome:

items.title: Workflow automation
items.body: We connect your tools and automate the manual, repetitive steps, with logging, approvals and error handling so it runs reliably in production.

items.title: AI copilots
items.body: We ship focused AI assistants that draft, triage and answer inside your existing systems, so your team moves faster without switching tools.

items.title: MVPs
items.body: We take a product idea to a deployed, production-ready MVP (authentication, core features and analytics) so you can validate quickly.

items.title: Team training
items.body: We run hands-on training, together with our accredited partners, that gets your team using AI, automation and modern development safely inside their real workflows, from half-day workshops to multi-week cohorts.

items.title: Fixed scope, custom quote
items.body: Every engagement is scoped up front and quoted per project. No hourly billing, no surprises. You know exactly what's included before we start.

items.title: GDPR-by-design
items.body: Data protection is built in from day one: least-privilege access, optional DPAs, agreed retention and a clear audit trail, not bolted on afterwards.

items.title: Transparent by default
items.body: We publish the sub-processors we use, notify you of material changes, and keep our trust and compliance details open for review.

items.title: Delivered in weeks
items.body: We work in short, demo-driven cycles, so you see progress early and ship in weeks, not quarters.

cta.title: Ready to see what we'd automate first?
cta.body: Book a short call and we'll map the highest-impact workflow, copilot or MVP for your team, and give you a fixed scope within 48 hours.
